daas-irab:68-68.t: ﴿فِيهِما﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿فاكِهَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ﴾ both conjoined to what precedes them; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:70-70.t: ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خَيْراتٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حِسانٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of خيرات; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:72-72.t: ﴿حُورٌ﴾ a badal (substitute) from خيرات. ﴿مَقْصُوراتٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of حور. ﴿فِي الْخِيامِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) مقصورات; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿مُتَّكِئِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلى رَفْرَفٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them. ﴿خُضْرٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of رفرف. ﴿وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ﴾ conjoined to رفرف. ﴿حِسانٍ﴾ a ṣifa of عبقري.

daas-irab:78-78.t: ﴿تَبارَكَ اسْمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ذِي﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of ربك, and it is muḍāf. ﴿الْجَلالِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْإِكْرامِ﴾ conjoined to الجلال; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:1-4.t: ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَلَقَ الْإِنْسانَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is a second khabar. ﴿عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيانَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; البيان is its second mafʿūl; the clause is a third khabar.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿الشَّمْسُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَالْقَمَرُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it. ﴿بِحُسْبانٍ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَالنَّجْمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَالشَّجَرُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it. ﴿يَسْجُدانِ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَالسَّماءَ﴾ a conjunction, and mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned. ﴿رَفَعَها﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is explicative (tafsīriyya) and has no grammatical position, and the implied clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزانَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿أَلَّا﴾ an is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative, and lā is negating. ﴿تَطْغَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي الْمِيزانِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by an implied preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to وضع.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وَأَقِيمُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْوَزْنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تُخْسِرُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْمِيزانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned; the implied clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَضَعَها﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلْأَنامِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿فِيها﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿فاكِهَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالنَّخْلُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فاكهة. ﴿ذاتُ﴾ an adjective. ﴿الْأَكْمامِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَالْحَبُّ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فاكهة. ﴿ذُو﴾ an adjective. ﴿الْعَصْفِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالرَّيْحانُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿فَبِأَيِّ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (fāʾ of elucidation), and بأي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكذبان. ﴿آلاءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبِّكُما﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تُكَذِّبانِ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿خَلَقَ الْإِنْسانَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ صَلْصالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَالْفَخَّارِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of صلصال.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِنْ مارِجٍ﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿مِنْ نارٍ﴾ an adjective of مارج; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿رَبُّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), annexed to المشرقين. ﴿الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَرَبُّ الْمَغْرِبَيْنِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَلْتَقِيانِ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the alif is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿بَيْنَهُما بَرْزَخٌ﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate) and a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ negating; and ﴿يَبْغِيانِ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿يَخْرُجُ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْهُمَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللُّؤْلُؤُ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative. ﴿وَالْمَرْجانُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اللؤلؤ; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿الْجَوارِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿الْمُنْشَآتُ﴾ an adjective of الجوار. ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) المنشئات. ﴿كَالْأَعْلامِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿كُلُّ مَنْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) annexed to the relative noun, and the relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فانٍ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ, it being a defective noun (ism manqūṣ); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَيَبْقى وَجْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ذُو﴾ an adjective of وجه, in construct (muḍāf). ﴿الْجَلالِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْإِكْرامِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الجلال; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿يَسْئَلُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿مَنْ﴾ its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ an adverb, in construct (muḍāf). ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي شَأْنٍ﴾ khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿سَنَفْرُغُ﴾ the sīn is for futurity, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَيُّهَ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda). ﴿الثَّقَلانِ﴾ badal (substitute); the vocative clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿يا مَعْشَرَ﴾ a vocative (munādā) in construct. ﴿الْجِنِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْإِنْسِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ﴾ in is a conditional particle, and a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْ تَنْفُذُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and what follows it is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of استطعتم. ﴿مِنْ أَقْطارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿فَانْفُذُوا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَنْفُذُونَ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِسُلْطانٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿يُرْسَلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿شُواظٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ نارٍ﴾ an adjective of شواظ. ﴿وَنُحاسٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to شواظ. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lā is negating. ﴿تَنْتَصِرانِ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿فَإِذَا﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption, and إذا is an adverbial conditional particle not governing the jussive. ﴿انْشَقَّتِ السَّماءُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَكانَتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَرْدَةً﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كَالدِّهانِ﴾ an adjective of وردة.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿فَيَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and يومئذ is an adverb of time annexed to idh. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُسْئَلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿عَنْ ذَنْبِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِنْسٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is the apodosis. ﴿وَلا جَانٌّ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to إنس.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِسِيماهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَيُؤْخَذُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿بِالنَّواصِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun standing in the place of the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿وَالْأَقْدامِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to النواصي; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿هذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted saying. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ an adjective of جهنم. ﴿يُكَذِّبُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿بِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿يَطُوفُونَ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بَيْنَها﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿وَبَيْنَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بينها. ﴿حَمِيمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آنٍ﴾ an adjective of حميم, genitive (majrūr) by the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the omitted yāʾ.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَلِمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿خافَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَقامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿جَنَّتانِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of man, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿ذَواتا﴾ an adjective of جنتان. ﴿أَفْنانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فِيهِما﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿عَيْنانِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause has no grammatical position. ﴿تَجْرِيانِ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the alif is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is an adjective of عينان.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿فَبِأَيِّ آلاءِ رَبِّكُما تُكَذِّبانِ﴾ its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿فِيهِما﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فاكِهَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿زَوْجانِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿مُتَّكِئِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿عَلى فُرُشٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them. ﴿بَطائِنُها﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is an adjective of فرش. ﴿وَجَنَى﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ in construct (muḍāf). ﴿الْجَنَّتَيْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿دانٍ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:56-56.t: ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿قاصِراتُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), in construct (muḍāf). ﴿الطَّرْفِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿إِنْسٌ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿وَلا جَانٌّ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to إنس.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿كَأَنَّهُنَّ﴾ كأن and its noun. ﴿الْياقُوتُ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالْمَرْجانُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الياقوت; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿هَلْ﴾ a particle of interrogation. ﴿جَزاءُ الْإِحْسانِ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) annexed to الإحسان. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْإِحْسانِ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source vowels the khabar with kasra (الْإِحْسانِ); as khabar the Quranic word is الْإِحْسانُ.]

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿وَمِنْ دُونِهِما﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿جَنَّتانِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:66-66.t: [Translator's note: the source text of this entry is garbled: the quotation brackets and first letters of the Quranic words are lost (it reads «ِيهِما», «يْنانِ», «ضَّاخَتانِ»). The words are restored below from the verse, ﴿فِيهِما عَيْنانِ نَضَّاخَتانِ﴾.] ﴿فِيهِما﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿عَيْنانِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَضَّاخَتانِ﴾ an adjective of عينان; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.
